what: Photo·text blocks are revealed as if spreading from top to bottom through a blurry mask with a wavy edge — a square mask (35% opaque at the top, wavy blurred edge, empty at the bottom) at 2x the element height is kept pinned to the bottom edge and hidden, then once the top edge reaches the bottom of the screen it scales up 9x over 2.3s while pinned to the top edge. Opacity clears in the first 20%. Because the mask is square, blocks wider than 2x their height are revealed later on the right (as in the original). Plays once
note: The original used mask.webp (a wavy square alpha image with blurred edges). The part redraws the same shape as an SVG (Gaussian blur 34) and keeps it as a data URI

from.where: shared.css [data-fade] (headings, text and photos across rooms, spa, dogs, dining, news, access and booking — original common.css mask-animation)
